# rms_devices (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of Teltonika RMS Devices.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rms_devices" "all" {}

data "rms_devices" "online" {
  company_id = 12345
  status     = "online"
}

output "device_names" {
  value = data.rms_devices.all.devices[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `company_id` (Number) Filter by company ID.
- `status` (String) Filter by status: online, offline, not_activated.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) List of devices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `id` (String) The identifier for this data source.

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `device_series` (String)
- `firmware` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `imei` (String)
- `mac` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `serial` (String)
- `status` (String)
